programme.title: Imagens De Marca
programme.desc: Programa: Imagens de Marca - S24Alinhamento nº 47Emissão de: 22 novembro 2026Tema: Marcas, inovação e novas oportunidadesSINOPSE DA EMISSÃO: Nesta edição, damos a conhecer histórias de marcas e negócios que se distinguem pela inovação, sustentabilidade e capacidade de criar experiências de valor. A Planta Livre aposta na economia circular com a criação da ProSolo, uma nova marca dedicada à produção de substratos e corretivos orgânicos, valorizando recursos locais e soluções mais sustentáveis. O Lidl assinala o Natal com uma iniciativa solidária dedicada à população sénior, reforçando a importância de cuidar de quem já cuidou de nós. Já a YoPRO procura ir além do produto e construir uma comunidade em torno do desporto, da nutrição, da recuperação e da música. A Zurich apresenta a sua estratégia para os Planos Poupança Reforma, numa aposta que pretende incentivar a poupança e reforçar a literacia financeira dos portugueses. E viajamos ainda até Lisboa para conhecer o Belcanto, do chef José Avillez, onde a tradição e a inovação se encontram numa experiência gastronómica que leva a cozinha portuguesa a um patamar de excelência. Uma edição que celebra o empreendedorismo, a criatividade e a capacidade das marcas de acompanhar os desafios e as oportunidades do futuro.______________________________________________Reportagem: Planta Livre aposta na economia circular com a marca ProSoloJornalista: Andreia Costinha Miranda\t \t\t\t\tTempo: 3’00”Oráculos: Armindo Gonçalves - Sócio-gerente Planta LivreSinopse da peça: Com duas décadas de experiência na produção de plantas ornamentais, a Planta Livre dá agora um novo passo na atividade, alargando o negócio à produção de substratos e corretivos orgânicos, através da criação da marca ProSolo. Instalada em Cabeceiras de Basto, a nova unidade industrial representa um investimento superior a 10 milhões de euros e aposta na inovação e no aproveitamento de resíduos e matérias-primas locais, como os provenientes da floresta e da indústria da madeira. O objetivo é reduzir a dependência da turfa, promovendo soluções mais sustentáveis e colocando a economia circular no centro do negócio. Numa primeira fase, o projeto prevê a criação de 15 postos de trabalho, com a expectativa de chegar aos 30 nos próximos cinco anos, e pretende conquistar mercados além-fronteiras.______________________________________________Reportagem: Cuidar de quem já cuidou de nósJornalista: Catarina Ganhão \t\t\t\t \t\tTempo: 3’00”Sinopse da peça: Num país cada vez mais envelhecido, cuidar de quem já cuidou de nós é um desafio que exige o envolvimento de toda a sociedade. É neste contexto que o Lidl lança a sua iniciativa solidária de Natal, dedicada ao apoio à população sénior, sob o mote «A Magia de cuidar de quem já cuidou de nós vale mesmo a pena». Para assinalar o arranque da campanha, o Lidl reuniu representantes das instituições, séniores e a embaixadora da iniciativa, Cláudia Vieira, num momento de partilha à volta da cozinha e da mesa. Mais do que uma campanha de Natal, uma iniciativa que coloca a solidariedade, a proximidade e o compromisso com a comunidade no centro da equação.______________________________________________Reportagem: YoPRO: para além do produto, uma comunidadeJornalista: Inês Freire\t\t\t \t\t\t\tTempo: 3´00”Oráculos: Diogo Costa – Diretor de Marketing e Diretor de Unidade de Negócios da Divisão de Lácteos da Danone Portugal; Sofia Tomás – Nutricionista e Criadora de Conteúdos DigitaisSinopse da peça: Presente no mercado português desde 2018, a YoPRO procura reforçar o seu posicionamento e ir além da associação aos iogurtes ricos em proteína e ao universo do desporto. A marca está a alargar a sua estratégia em torno de quatro territórios — desporto, nutrição, recuperação e música —, com o objetivo de criar uma comunidade e aproximar-se dos consumidores através de experiências e iniciativas como o YoPRO Day. O evento reuniu atividades físicas, momentos dedicados à recuperação e música, numa experiência que procurou tornar o bem-estar mais acessível e próximo de diferentes públicos. Em paralelo, a marca pretende prolongar esta ligação ao longo do ano, reforçando a presença digital com conteúdos sobre treino e nutrição e apostando na partilha de experiências reais. A estratégia passa ainda pelo alargamento do portefólio, com novas propostas e momentos de consumo.______________________________________________Reportagem: Zurich pensa na reformaJornalista: Fernando Paula\t\t\t \t\t Tempo: 03’00”Sinopse da peça: A mais recente campanha de comunicação da Zurich está focada num produto que é estratégico para o negócio da seguradora: os PPR’s, planos de poupança reforma. A campanha é lançada e está no ar ao longo do último trimestre do ano, época relevante para a venda deste tipo de produtos no mercado. Fátima Lopes dá a cara pela campanha e a marca dá a conhecer todo o racional deste momento de comunicação, ao mesmo tempo que explica toda a estratégia de negócio, não só quando se fala de PPR mas também quando se pretende aumentar a Literacia Financeira dos portugueses. ______________________________________________Reportagem: Belcanto: entre a tradição e a inovaçãoJornalista: Andreia Costinha Miranda \t\t\t\t\tTempo: 3’00”Oráculos: José Avillez - Chef BelcantoNádia Desidério - Dir. Restaurante I Head Sommelier BelcantoSinopse da peça: Na rubrica Portugal à Mesa, fomos até Lisboa para conhecer o Belcanto, do chef José Avillez, um dos nomes maiores da gastronomia portuguesa. Com duas estrelas Michelin e um lugar de destaque entre os melhores restaurantes do mundo, o Belcanto propõe uma viagem gastronómica e sensorial única, onde a cozinha portuguesa contemporânea se cruza com a tradição e a inovação. Instalado no coração do Chiado, num ambiente sofisticado que liga o romantismo da Lisboa antiga a uma visão de futuro, o restaurante distingue-se também pela qualidade do serviço e por uma garrafeira de excelência, com grandes referências nacionais e internacionais. Estivemos à mesa para descobrir os sabores, as histórias e a criatividade que fazem deste espaço uma referência da gastronomia nacional e o palco da visão de José Avillez sobre a cozinha portuguesa.

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: The world's top bodyguard Michael Bryce gets a chaotic new client: notorious hitman Darius Kincaid. With enemies on their tail, they must put aside their differences to get Darius to court alive and on time.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Venice
programme.desc: To get his beloved dog back, L.A. private eye Steve Ford teams up with his depressive best friend, his lazy assistant, and a diabolical drug dealer.

programme.title: A Working Man
programme.desc: Levon Cade leaves a career in black ops to live a simple life, but his quiet world is interrupted when his boss's daughter is kidnapped. His search to bring her home uncovers a world of corruption.

programme.title: The Grey
programme.desc: When their plane crashes in the Alaskan wilderness, John Ottway must lead his team of oil-rig roughnecks through the icy elements as a pack of hungry wolves haunts their every step.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: Kyle Reese is sent back to 1984 to protect Sarah Connor. But when the timeline fractures, Reese is thrust into a new and unfamiliar version of the past.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: After being betrayed and left for dead in Italy, a thief and his crew travel to L.A. with a plan to steal back their fortune and bring down their double-crossing former ally.

programme.title: Love Lies Bleeding
programme.desc: Reclusive gym manager Lou falls hard for Jackie, an ambitious bodybuilder. But their love ignites violence, pulling them deep into the web of Lou's criminal family.

programme.title: Get the Gringo
programme.desc: A career criminal is nabbed by Mexican authorities and placed in a tough prison. There, he learns to survive with the help of a young boy.

programme.title: The Collective
programme.desc: A group of righteous assassins known as The Collective takes aim at a human trafficking ring that's backed by a network of untouchable billionaires.

programme.title: 21 Bridges
programme.desc: An embattled NYPD detective joins a citywide manhunt for two young cop killers. He convinces the authorities to lockdown Manhattan, closing all 21 bridges, tunnels, and access points to prevent the suspects from escaping.

programme.title: Arsenal
programme.desc: Two brothers grow up to be very different people - one a business owner and one a petty mobster. When one brother is kidnapped and held for a ransom, the other must risk everything to save him.

programme.title: The Death and Life of Bobby Z
programme.desc: An incarcerated former Marine gets a chance to earn his freedom. All he needs to do is impersonate a recently deceased drug kingpin.

programme.title: Blood Father
programme.desc: An ex-con is thrust back into a life of violence when his estranged daughter bursts back into his life, with a ruthless gang in close pursuit.

programme.title: Prisoners Of The Ghostland
programme.desc: Strapped into a suit that will self-destruct in five days, a notorious bank robber is ordered to find a wealthy warlord's runaway granddaughter.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: With governments and enemies on their trail, Ethan Hunt and the IMF team search for the Entity - a rogue AI that could destroy mankind.

programme.title: Fury
programme.desc: During WWII, battle-hardened army sergeant Don 'Wardaddy' Collier leads the crew of a Sherman tank on a mission behind enemy lines. Outnumbered and outgunned, the soldiers face overwhelming odds as they strike at the heart of Nazi Germany.

programme.title: The Sweeney
programme.desc: Detective Inspector Jack Regan and his partner George Carter are old-school crime fighters enforcing the law in a modern underworld.

programme.title: Catwoman
programme.desc: In Gotham City, a mild-mannered graphic designer stumbles upon a dark secret. Transformed into Catwoman, with the strength, speed and ultra-keen sense of a cat, she becomes a fearless vigilante.

programme.title: A Clear Shot
programme.desc: An electronic store erupts into chaos when four gunmen storm the premises, taking shoppers and employees hostage. Sacramento PD's top negotiator is brought in to resolve the situation and prevent a tragedy. Based on real events.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: A team of elite mercenaries takes on a mission to overthrow a blood-thirsty dictator in South America - a job no official military unit is willing to touch.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: The Expendables reunite for what should be an easy mission, but when one of their men is murdered on the job, their quest for revenge puts them deep in enemy territory and up against an unexpected threat.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: A CIA recruit is caught in a dangerous web of intrigue and espionage as he fights to stop a devastating plot against the United States.

programme.title: The Last Gunfight
programme.desc: In a ruthless underground tournament, the world's top assassins fight to the death. However, amongst them is a rogue crew with their own lethal agenda.

programme.title: A Warrior's Heart
programme.desc: After his father's death, high school lacrosse star Conor becomes angry and destructive, but a new love interest and a wilderness training camp help him rediscover the warrior within.

programme.title: Prisoner of War
programme.desc: During WWII, British RAF Wing Commander James Wright is caught and imprisoned in a Japanese internment camp. Wright must not only survive, but also fight in brutal martial arts matches organized by his captors for their entertainment.

programme.title: Unlocked
programme.desc: CIA interrogator Alice Racine is called into action when she uncovers plans for a deadly biological attack on the citizens of London.

programme.title: The 355
programme.desc: When a top-secret weapon falls into mercenary hands, a wild card CIA agent joins forces with three international operatives on a lethal mission to retrieve it.

programme.title: RED
programme.desc: Retired black-ops CIA agent Frank Moses is living a quiet life alone - until the day a hit squad shows up to kill him. Frank must reunite his old team in a last-ditch effort to survive, and find out who wants him dead.

programme.title: Brothers in Arms
programme.desc: Cal is a by-the-book police officer and Marine Corps reservist. When his reckless younger brother is arrested, Cal must decide how far he'll go to fight for his family.

programme.title: Dirty
programme.desc: Over the course of one day, a gangbanger-turned-cop is forced to choose between his conscience and his loyalty to the code of blue.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Thrilled by his experience with the Avengers, Peter returns home, where he lives with his Aunt May. Under the watchful eye of his new mentor Tony Stark, he begins to navigate his life as high-school teen and secret super-hero.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: After the death of his fiancee at the hands of terrorists, Mitch Rapp is drawn into the world of counterterrorism, mentored by a tough-as-nails former Navy S.E.A.L. Stan Hurley.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
programme.desc: Even your friendly neighborhood superhero can use a vacation. But a new threat forces Peter Parker to swing into action during a school trip to Europe.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Hot shot fighter pilot Maverick is out to become the best of the best in the Navy's elite Top Gun school. But as a talented yet reckless flyer he's got a lot to learn.

programme.title: Bad Man
programme.desc: After a drug-related murder shakes his small town, Deputy Sam Evans finds himself working with undercover agent Bobby Gaines, a hotshot narcotics officer who doesn't play by the rules.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: A ruthless former comrade is back and on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross augments the team with new recruits, leading to a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.

programme.title: Relentless
programme.desc: A destitute man breaks into the home of an elite cybersecurity expert, igniting a tense game of cat-and-mouse that spirals into blood-spattered chaos - but it'll take an unhinged level of brutality to reveal his true motive.

programme.title: Long Gone Heroes
programme.desc: An ex-special forces soldier is forced back into the field to save his niece, who has been kidnapped in South America. As the fight intensifies, he and his team discover that her disappearance is part of a something much bigger.

programme.title: RED 2
programme.desc: Retired black-ops CIA agent Frank Moses reunites his unlikely team of elite operatives once again - this time for a globe-trotting mission tracking down a missing portable nuclear device.

programme.title: Three Kings
programme.desc: At the end of the Gulf War, a small band of American soldiers seek adventure and fortune by attempting to steal a huge cache of gold hidden somewhere in the desert.

programme.title: Apocalypto
programme.desc: Set against the turbulent end times of ancient Mayan civilisation, a young man is captured for ritual sacrifice and must make a desperate bid to escape his fate and get back to the family he loves. Contains English Subtitles.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
programme.desc: With his secret exposed, Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange to make the world forget. But when the spell goes wrong and unleashes dangerous foes from other worlds, Peter is forced to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

programme.title: Border Hunters
programme.desc: Former spy Abraham Woodhill enlists an imprisoned ex-operative for a high-stakes mission that takes him through Mexico's jungles, villages, and cartel strongholds.

programme.title: Act of Valour
programme.desc: An elite team of Navy SEALs embark on a covert mission to recover a kidnapped CIA agent from a lethal terrorist cell. Filmed using a cast of real-life active-duty US Navy SEALs.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: A dangerous storm forces Pilot Brodie Torrance to land his plane on a war-torn island. When his passengers are taken hostage, the only person Brodie can rely on is an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Journalist Eddie Brock develops superhuman strength and power when his body merges with an alien symbiote. Twisted, dark, and fuelled by rage, the creature tries to control the new and dangerous abilities that Eddie finds so intoxicating.

programme.title: Boiling Point
programme.desc: Jimmy Mercer is a cop on the edge. He has seven days before he’s transferred - and seven days to wreak revenge on the scum that killed his partner.

programme.title: Takers
programme.desc: A notorious group of criminals baffle police by pulling off elaborate heists. But on their biggest job yet - with $20 million at stake - their plans are interrupted by a hard-boiled detective hell-bent on solving the case.

programme.title: School For Scoundrels
programme.desc: A chronic loser hopes that a school that teaches one-upmanship will enable him to embarrass a rival and woo the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Dam Busters
programme.desc: Amidst the battlegrounds of WWII, a squadron of British RAF bombers attempts to cripple the Nazis by taking out their dams.

programme.title: Richard III
programme.desc: Having helped his brother King Edward IV take the throne of England, the jealous, hunchbacked, Richard plots to seize power for himself in Shakespeare's powerful tale of deception, manipulation, and outright murder.

programme.title: The Elephant Man
programme.desc: With a facial difference due to a rare disease, John Merrick is abused and ostracised, living his life as the 'Elephant Man' in a circus sideshow. However, Dr Treves sees the person beyond the deformities.

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: When Helen is fired and rushes out to catch a train home, her life splits into two parallel realities. In one world, she catches the train; in the other, she misses it - one split second leads her on two different journeys of the heart.

programme.title: The Power of One
programme.desc: Through his boxing prowess, an English boy living in South Africa becomes a symbol of hope during a time of war.

programme.title: Rosemary's Baby
programme.desc: A young mother-to-be grows increasingly suspicious that her overfriendly elderly neighbours are hatching a satanic plot against her and her unborn baby.

programme.title: One From the Heart
programme.desc: On the anniversary of their five-year romance, Hank and Frannie decide to go their separate ways. Over one night in Las Vegas, they each seek comfort elsewhere. Featuring songs by Tom Waits and Crystal Gale.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Under the guidance of a master of the martial arts, a teenage boy develops the faith and self-confidence to overcome tremendous odds.

programme.title: Clockwise
programme.desc: Headmaster Brian Stimpson is fanatical about being on time. But when he boards the wrong train on his way to a conference he finds himself in a nightmarish journey of misunderstandings, ex-girlfriends, unruly Sixth Formers and even the police.

programme.title: Purple Rain
programme.desc: Tormented by an abusive situation at home, a talented young musician must contend with a rival singer, a burgeoning romance, and his own dissatisfied band.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The uniquely macabre Addams Family and their kooky household are surprised by a visit from their long lost Uncle Fester. But is Uncle Fester really everything he seems?

programme.title: Memoirs of an Invisible Man
programme.desc: An experiment goes wrong and renders innocent bystander Nick invisible. Pursued by a tyrannical CIA operative, Nick tries to adjust to his new reality.

programme.title: The Deer Hunter
programme.desc: The lives of three small-town steel mill workers are changed forever after fighting in the Vietnam War, the experience leaving them with terrible physical and psychological wounds.

programme.title: Three Days of the Condor

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley, Nat Adderley, Yusuf Lateef & Joe Zawinul
programme.desc: Cannonball Adderley: Live in '63 boasts two beautifully filmed concerts from one of the most celebrated sextets in jazz history, captured at the top of their game. Cannonball Adderley (alto sax), Nat Adderley (cornet), and the masterful Yusef Lateef (tenor sax, flute, oboe), provide a massive three-horn frontline attack, while the stellar rhythm section featuring a pre-Weather Report Joe Zawinul (piano), Sam Jones (bass), and Louis Hayes (drums) fuel the songs with a deep infectious swing. Quincy Jones' "Jessica's Day" leaps from the gate with a huge big band sound that is extraordinary for only six musicians. This recording is a reminder that Cannonball Adderley was one of the most outstanding and highly respected alto saxophonists in the history of jazz. He was a bluesy jazzman who could play anything in superb fashion.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Ray Charles & The Raelettes
programme.sub-title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1980, American soul legend Ray Charles brought the Raelettes and the Ray Charles Orchestra to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With the full force of these two groups behind him, Charles showed why throughout his storied career he has been viewed as one of the most recognizable voices in music.

programme.title: Elizabeth Shepherd
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Larry Graham
programme.sub-title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers' came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London's Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect. Bennett is accompanied by his musical director Torrie Zito and an orchestra of British musicians that includes Kenny Clare (drums), Don Lusher (trombone), and Kenny Baker (trumpet). Tune in for Bennett's captivating take on songs “The Good Things in Life”, “My Favorite Things”, “My Love”, “I've Got Five Dollars”, “It Don't Mean a Thing”, and “Maybe This Time” in this magical concert recording.

programme.title: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited' tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto, Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Ruxandra Donose & Ramón Vargas
programme.sub-title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler's song-symphony — one of the composer's most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Alice In Chains
programme.desc: In their first live concert in over 2 years (and possibly their last concert ever), Alternative/metal group Alice in Chains performs acoustically at MTV Unplugged. Includes acoustic versions of the hit songs "Got Me Wrong," "Rooster," "Would?," and "Down in a Hole."

programme.title: Coldplay
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Neil Young
programme.desc: Following on from this label's previous Neil Young DVD documentary, The First Decade, comes this second instalment focusing on the great man's career between the years 1976 and 2006 with the help of obscure archive footage, rare film of Neil Young in performance and in the studio and contributions from those he worked with closely during this period.

programme.title: Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: Beginning with a searing indictment of slavery, the first episode of this series dramatically evokes the causes of the American Civil War. Here are the burning questions of Union and States' rights, John Brown at Harper's Ferry, the election of Abraham Lincoln in 1860, the firing on Fort Sumter and the rush to arms. Major figures such as Lincoln, Lee and Grant are introduced while the episode concludes with the disastrous Union defeat at Manassas, Virginia. Part 1 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: The second episode in the series begins with the political infighting that threatened to swamp Lincoln's administration and then follows Union General George McClellan's ill-fated campaign on the Virginia Peninsula, where his huge army meets a smaller but more resourceful Confederate force. The programme also focuses on Ulysses S Grant, whose exploits come to a bloody climax at the Battle of Shiloh in Tennessee, and concludes with rumours of Europe's readiness to recognise the Confederacy. Part 2 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: Convinced by July 1862 that emancipation was now morally and militarily crucial to the future of the Union, Lincoln waits for a victory to issue his proclamation. As the year wears on there are no Union victories forthcoming thanks to the brilliance of Stonewall Jackson and Robert E Lee. In September 1862 Lee invades Maryland and on the banks of Antietam Creek, the bloodiest day of the war takes place, followed shortly by the brightest: the emancipation of the slaves. Part 3 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: The fourth programme in the series reveals how the Union disaster at Fredericksburg prefaced further successes for the Confederacy. At Chancellorsville in May, Lee wins his most brilliant victory but loses Stonewall Jackson, and at Vicksburg, Grant's attempts to take the city by siege are stopped. The programme highlights the fierce Northern opposition to Lincoln's Emancipation Proclamation and ends with Lee's decision to invade the North again to draw Grant's forces away from Vicksburg. Part 4 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: This episode opens with a dramatic account of the Battle of Gettysburg in which 150,000 men fight to the death in Pennsylvania over a period of three days, culminating in Pickett's legendary charge. Also chronicled are the fall of Vicksburg, the New York draft riots, the first use of black troops, and the battles at Chickamauga, Georgia and Chattanooga. The episode closes with Abraham Lincoln in Gettysburg where he struggles to articulate what is happening to his people. Part 5 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: Episode six of the series begins with a biographical comparison of Ulysses S Grant and Robert E Lee and then chronicles the extraordinary series of battles that pitted the two generals against each other, from the wilderness to Petersburg in Virginia. In 30 days, the two armies lose more men than both sides have lost in three years of war. The programme also follows General Sherman's Atlanta campaign through the mountains of north Georgia. Part 6 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: The presidential election of 1864 sets Abraham Lincoln against his old commanding general, George McClellan. The survival of the Union itself is at stake as opinion in the North turns strongly against the war. Victories at Mobile Bay, Atlanta and the Shenandoah Valley tilt the election to Lincoln and the Confederacy's last hope for independence dies. Lee's Arlington mansion is turned into a Union military hospital and the estate becomes Arlington National Cemetery. Part 7 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: William Tecumseh Sherman's brilliant march to the sea brings the war to the heart of Georgia and the Carolinas and spells the end of the Confederacy. In March, following Lincoln's second inauguration, Petersburg and Richmond finally fall to Grant's army. Lee's tattered Army of Northern Virginia flees westward towards a tiny crossroads town called Appomattox Court House. There the dramatic and deeply moving surrender of Lee to Grant takes place. Part 8 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: The final episode of the series begins with the aftermath of Lee's surrender and then narrates the events of five days later when, on 14 April, Lincoln is assassinated. After chronicling Lincoln's poignant funeral, the series recounts the final days of the war, the capture of John Wilkes Booth and the fates of the Civil War's major protagonists. The episode then considers the consequences and meaning of a war that transformed the country from a collection of states to the nation it is today. Part 9 of 9.

After chronicling Lincoln's poignant funeral, the series recounts the final days of the war, the capture of John Wilkes Booth and the fates of the Civil War's major protagonists. The episode then considers the consequences and meaning of a war that transformed the country from a collection of states to the nation it is today. Part 9 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: Beginning with a searing indictment of slavery, the first episode of this series dramatically evokes the causes of the American Civil War. Here are the burning questions of Union and States' rights, John Brown at Harper's Ferry, the election of Abraham Lincoln in 1860, the firing on Fort Sumter and the rush to arms. Major figures such as Lincoln, Lee and Grant are introduced while the episode concludes with the disastrous Union defeat at Manassas, Virginia. Part 1 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: The second episode in the series begins with the political infighting that threatened to swamp Lincoln's administration and then follows Union General George McClellan's ill-fated campaign on the Virginia Peninsula, where his huge army meets a smaller but more resourceful Confederate force. The programme also focuses on Ulysses S Grant, whose exploits come to a bloody climax at the Battle of Shiloh in Tennessee, and concludes with rumours of Europe's readiness to recognise the Confederacy. Part 2 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: Convinced by July 1862 that emancipation was now morally and militarily crucial to the future of the Union, Lincoln waits for a victory to issue his proclamation. As the year wears on there are no Union victories forthcoming thanks to the brilliance of Stonewall Jackson and Robert E Lee. In September 1862 Lee invades Maryland and on the banks of Antietam Creek, the bloodiest day of the war takes place, followed shortly by the brightest: the emancipation of the slaves. Part 3 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: The fourth programme in the series reveals how the Union disaster at Fredericksburg prefaced further successes for the Confederacy. At Chancellorsville in May, Lee wins his most brilliant victory but loses Stonewall Jackson, and at Vicksburg, Grant's attempts to take the city by siege are stopped. The programme highlights the fierce Northern opposition to Lincoln's Emancipation Proclamation and ends with Lee's decision to invade the North again to draw Grant's forces away from Vicksburg. Part 4 of 9.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: This episode opens with a dramatic account of the Battle of Gettysburg in which 150,000 men fight to the death in Pennsylvania over a period of three days, culminating in Pickett's legendary charge. Also chronicled are the fall of Vicksburg, the New York draft riots, the first use of black troops, and the battles at Chickamauga, Georgia and Chattanooga. The episode closes with Abraham Lincoln in Gettysburg where he struggles to articulate what is happening to his people. Part 5 of 9.
